messages:
olivia: deploy-bot put canary promotion on HOLD — build image layer cache mismatch for service/payments:sha-3e2b. deploy-bot: "cache-verify failed: expected layer id=layer-7b got=layer-ff (size mismatch)". do we pin to previous image or rebuild?

paul: looking at runner logs now. build completed but extract failed on canary with overlayfs: unexpected EOF reading layer-7b. origin image in registry shows expected layer-7b. replica seems corrupted in nodepool cache.

ci-bot: CI_JOB artifact-verify: FAIL. "tar: unexpected EOF" on layer unpack. job link: https://ci/internal/12345

quinn: re-pulling image from registry on a clean node succeeds. so origin is fine. suspect ephemeral node cache corruption during image pull.

ravi: pinning to last-known-good image (service/payments:sha-2a1c) is safest for the release window. reuploading or rebuilding risks new digests and breaking reproducibility.

olivia: agree. minimal blast radius: pin to sha-2a1c for canary promote, open INF-3012 to investigate nodepool cache eviction + overlayfs corruption.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_HOLD: reason=layer-cache-mismatch, candidate=sha-3e2b, last_good=sha-2a1c, triggered_by=canary-smoke. awaiting manual_approve from olivia.

olivia: /deploybot approve promote canary --sha=2a1c --reason "pin last_good due to nodepool cache corruption"

deploy-bot: ACK. manual approval received. executing manual promote to sha-2a1c.

paul: manual promote ran, canary smoke passed on pinned image. deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: canary -> sha-2a1c. :white_check_mark:

quinn: INF-3012 created: investigate nodepool image cache integrity, add post-pull layer checksum verification and a cache healing job. assigning to infra team.

ravi: release note blurb: "Canary promotion pinned to previously verified image due to transient nodepool cache corruption; origin registry image unchanged. Follow-up: INF-3012."

olivia: action items: (1) pinned promote complete (paul) (2) INF-3012 assigned (quinn) (3) add post-pull verify + cache-heal (ravi) (4) draft release note (olivia). closing once ticket visible in Jira.
